description:
Use this when you need broad 2026-2028 working-day reference coverage and accept national-scope open-derived semantics rather than a direct authority calendar. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when you need an official direct authority, a regional/employer/bank/exchange calendar, a legal determination, or a date outside 2026-2028; use the official China/UK package or the CLDR baseline as appropriate.
What it computes: Checks a date across 246 country/territory codes using a pinned OpenWorkdays national-scope public-holiday reference, country weekend rules and explicit working-weekend dates, with estimated/observed flags and non-authority limits.
Example user requests: Is 2026-10-26 a working day in Australia using the broad national reference? | Check 2027-02-25 in Saudi Arabia and show whether the holiday date is estimated.
Inputs: date (date); territory (enum).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-10-26","territory":"AU"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, source_territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, weekend_days, working_weekend_day, holiday_names, holiday_observed, holiday_estimated, holiday_policy, calendar_scope, calendar_profile, substitute_day_policy, source_quality, dataset_version, coverage_start, coverage_end, source_url.
Formula: is_working_day = not source_weekend(date) and not source_public_holiday(date, country); explicit source working-weekend dates override the weekend classification
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/global-reference-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/global-reference-working-day.md

territory.description: ISO-style alpha-2 country code supported by the pinned OpenWorkdays reference snapshot.

name: check_global_reference_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: National reference plus country weekend and explicit working-weekend dates.

holiday_estimated.description: True when an included event is marked estimated by the source.

holiday_names.description: Included national-scope public-holiday names on the date.

holiday_observed.description: True when an included event is marked observed by the source.

holiday_policy.description: National-scope events with source observed/estimated flags preserved.

is_working_day.description: True when the date is neither a source country weekend nor an included public-holiday event.

source_quality.description: Open derived reference, not a direct national authority feed.

source_territory_name.description: Raw country name from the hash-pinned OpenWorkdays source catalogue.

substitute_day_policy.description: Source flags are preserved; no new substitute-day rule is inferred.

territory_name.description: Calcgrid display name; TW is displayed as 中国台湾省 while the machine code remains TW.

weekend_days.description: Weekend convention supplied by the source country file.

working_weekend_day.description: True when the source explicitly marks a weekend date as an official working day.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Global Working Day Reference
